lockedMove.speaker: Richard Dawkins
lockedMove.proposition: Christian institutional reach and organization do not establish moral fitness, as the Roman Catholic Church uses that capacity to promote harmful positions on abortion and contraception.
lockedMove.sourceExcerpt: The largest Christian Church at the moment is the Roman Catholic Church. They are the people who got the organisation going, they've got the whole of South America, they've hit an enormous number of people and what they stand for is total opposition to abortion, contraception. This is not a good organisation for morality
